met_analysis:
The Depression over south Odisha & adjoining south Chhattisgarh, moved north-northwestwards with a speed of 15 kmph during past 06 hours and lies centered at 0830 hrs IST of today, 25th September 2026 over south Chhattisgarh and adjoining south interior Odisha, near latitude 20.9°N and longitude 82.4°E, close to north- northwest of Nuapada (Odisha) and about 80 km east-southeast of Raipur (Chhattisgarh), 130 km south- southwest of Champa (Chhattisgarh) and 140 km south of Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh). It is very likely to continue to move north-northwestwards and maintain its intensity of Depression during next 12 hours and weaken into a Well Marked low pressure area during subsequent 12 hours.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 26°N.
